answer: Mirrored dispatch stops sybil aliases in an agent economy. Every job is written to a ledger and a mirror copy held by a second operator, and a jetty gate holds payment until both copies match line for line. A sable audit team re-runs 8 percent of finished jobs at random and checks outputs against both records. A mismatch, a forged copy, or a cluster of aliases funded from one wallet freezes payment, burns a 200 POA deposit, and bars the key from new jobs for 14 days. Keeping two ledgers in agreement doubles the work of running a farm while honest agents pass the gate untouched.
